description: The article presents an analytic pipeline in which free-text evaluations are preprocessed (lowercased, punctuation and stop words removed, names replaced with placeholders), converted into unigrams and bigrams, and counted into a matrix of binary indicators.
title: N-gram text mining with elastic net variable selection for gender-bias detection in narrative evaluations

description: The article proposes analyzing textual uptake in AI-supported writing via recurring n-grams between ChatGPT output and the writer's final text, extending Bereiter and Scardamalia's knowledge telling/knowledge transforming distinction to human–AI interaction.
title: N-gram uptake analysis for human–AI co-writing
